Region-restriction modal 564x658 - DEFERRED BY DESIGN, deliberately NOT built, and surfaced as a recommendation instead. The app ALREADY implements region denial in src/components/auth/GeoRestrictedRoute.tsx, and the standing product decision is that region denial is a modal with gameplay left on. Building this frame would give the app a SECOND competing region modal on one concern, so the frame's copy is recorded in scratchersPageContent.ts (SCRATCHERS_REGION_MODAL_DEFERRED, imported by nothing) for review and the differences from what already renders are reported to the caller. GeoRestrictedRoute.tsx is not owned by this task and was not edited.
